setlist.title: It Must Have Been The Roses

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **So Many Roads** (2 reviews): Jerry's singing on this track is described as a best out-of-body experience; Jerry's ending to the song is described as a mind-rupturing, eternal moment [9][13]
- **Wang Dang Doodle** (1 review): Jerry gets into the horns during this strong opening track [14]
- **Loose Lucy** (1 review): Great performance, though Jerry mixes up some lyrics, like 'She's my YoYo' [17]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Jerry's voice is described as shot, causing an 'oh my God' sensation [10]
- **Days Between** (1 review): Jerry solos between verses, possibly forgetting lyrics, a unique occurrence for this tune [7]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-12-19.sedt1-aud.set2-sbd.ladner.10112.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 172 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Static during first verse of Roses, sounding like a loose cord [1]
- **gd1993-12-19.sbd.miller.91963.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 180 min; rated 3/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: Jerry's guitar sounds different here, almost acoustic and naked [17]
- **gd93-12-19.aud.vernon.7349.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 177 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [3]. Said about its sound: Audio quality is noted as quite nice for the Coliseum venue [7]
- **gd93-12-19.sbd.braverman.12573.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 170 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer waited all night in line for a front-row view of Jerry [8]
- Jerry's voice was not strong, suggesting he was battling a cold [14]
- Band consumed Hegenberger before the show, contributing to a froggy sound [16]
- Venue was spacious then, but later became a huge bar, changing the atmosphere [16]
- Listener considers this the final solidly good performance on the band's home turf [6]
- Second most downloaded show for the listener, after the August 22, 1993 date [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-12-19.sedt1-aud.set2-sbd.ladner.10112.shnf**: transferred by Chris Ladner; source: Set 1: FOB AUD (unk. mic) > DAT > CDR; Set 2: SBD>MC>DAT>ZA2>CDR; [1]. Also: Thanks to Willy/Matt for set one and Paul B. for set two [1]
- **gd1993-12-19.sbd.miller.91963.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Thanks to Paul Scotton for the discs; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat -> CD D [2]
- **gd93-12-19.aud.vernon.7349.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Matt Vernon; source: Audience: Unknown Mics [3]. Also: Taped by listener, transferred to CDR, covering post-Brent era shows; Unknown FOB aud to DAT to CDR, via Ryan Varum and Matt Vernon [3][6]
- **gd93-12-19.sbd.braverman.12573.sbeok.shnf**: source: Set 1: SBD>DAT> Cassette> DAT> CD> SHNSet 2: SBD>MC>DAT>ZA2>CDR>WAV>SHN [4]
